results.description: From Saraswathi Muniappan NEW DELHI, Sept 13 (Bernama) -- Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim may have been in New Delhi for high-level diplomacy but his rendition of Kishore Kumar’s classic “Khwab Ho Tum Ya Koi Haqeeqat” struck a different chord, drawing positive reactions from many Indians.

results.title: Family Sues U.S. Art Dealer Over $6.7 Million in Fake Warhols
results.description: A Florida family says it paid $6.7 million for more than 200 fake Andy Warhol works and is suing the dealer who sold them.
